issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation uses 'Người' (He/The person) as a subject for the actions of 'chủ vườn nho' (the owner of the vineyard), but in the Greek, 'ο κυριος του αμπελωνος' is the subject of all three verbs: ελευσεται (will come), απολεσει (will destroy), and δωσει (will give). The Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like the owner asks a question and then a third person ('Người') performs the actions.
